To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the NLO corrections to VBS are large, positive and of the same order of magnitude as the QCD-induced background, which is also large, positive and receives a significant contribution from the NLO QCD corrections.
the total NLO QCD correction to the VBS contribution is −8% and the total NLO EW correction is +2%.
the NLO QCD corrections to the total cross section of the VBS process are about 30 % and that the NLO EW corrections are of the same size as the NLO QED corrections.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NLO electroweak effects are small compared to the NLO QCD corrections, which are of the order 10% and 15% for the VBS and the irreducible background, respectively.
we have completed all the NLO QCD corrections to VBS, and we provide the full NLO electroweak and NLO QCD+EW corrections to VBS for the first time.
the NLO QCD corrections are large and positive and reduce the scale uncertainty by about a factor of 2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the NLO corrections to VBS are moderate, but the QCD-induced background is enhanced by a factor of 2-3.
the full NLO corrections can be as large as 30% of the leading-order result.
the NLO QCD corrections to VBS are large, of the order 50% for the VBS process, and that the electroweak and QCD corrections to the irreducible background processes are also large.
